CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.append_advance_adjustment(p_adjustment jsonb, p_actor_id uuid)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
declare adjustment_id_value bigint;
begin
  if p_actor_id is null or not exists (select 1 from public.admin_users where user_id = p_actor_id) then raise exception 'Administrator access is required'; end if;
  perform set_config('request.jwt.claim.sub', p_actor_id::text, true);
  insert into public.advance_adjustments(advance_id, adjustment_type, amount_delta, reason, created_by)
  values (nullif(p_adjustment ->> 'advance_id', '')::bigint, p_adjustment ->> 'adjustment_type',
    nullif(p_adjustment ->> 'amount_delta', '')::numeric, btrim(p_adjustment ->> 'reason'), p_actor_id)
  returning id into adjustment_id_value;
  return adjustment_id_value;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.approve_salary_adjustment(p_adjustment_id bigint, p_actor_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql

AS $function$
begin
  if p_actor_id is null or not exists (select 1 from public.admin_users where user_id = p_actor_id) then raise exception 'Administrator access is required'; end if;
  perform set_config('request.jwt.claim.sub', p_actor_id::text, true);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION operations_private.audit_operations_change()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
declare
  old_value jsonb;
  new_value jsonb;
  row_data jsonb;
begin
  if tg_op = 'INSERT' then new_value := to_jsonb(new); row_data := new_value;
  elsif tg_op = 'UPDATE' then old_value := to_jsonb(old); new_value := to_jsonb(new); row_data := new_value;
  else old_value := to_jsonb(old); row_data := old_value;
  end if;
  insert into public.operations_audit_log(table_name, record_id, action, before_data, after_data, actor_id)
  values (tg_table_name, coalesce(row_data ->> 'id', ''), tg_op, old_value, new_value, auth.uid());
  if tg_op = 'DELETE' then return old; end if;
  return new;
end;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.claim_advance_sheet_sync(p_limit integer DEFAULT 20)
 RETURNS TABLE(advance_id bigint, employee_type text, employee_code text, employee_name text, site_code text, site_name text, amount numeric, occurred_at timestamp with time zone, payment_mode text, description text, source text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  with candidates as (
    select outbox.advance_id
    from public.advance_sheet_sync_outbox as outbox
    where outbox.synced_at is null
      and outbox.next_attempt_at <= now()
      and (outbox.locked_until is null or outbox.locked_until <= now())
    order by outbox.next_attempt_at, outbox.created_at, outbox.advance_id
    for update skip locked
    limit greatest(1, least(coalesce(p_limit, 20), 50))
  ), claimed as (
    update public.advance_sheet_sync_outbox as outbox
    set attempts = outbox.attempts + 1,
        locked_until = now() + interval '10 minutes',
        updated_at = now()
    from candidates
    where outbox.advance_id = candidates.advance_id
    returning outbox.advance_id
  )
  select advance.id,
    advance.employee_type,
    coalesce(guard.employee_code, supervisor.employee_code, officer.employee_code, ''),
    coalesce(guard.full_name, supervisor.full_name, officer.full_name, ''),
    coalesce(site.site_code, ''),
    coalesce(site.title, ''),
    advance.amount,
    advance.occurred_at,
    advance.payment_mode,
    advance.description,
    advance.source
  from claimed
  join public.advances as advance on advance.id = claimed.advance_id
  left join public.guards as guard on guard.id = advance.guard_id
  left join public.supervisors as supervisor on supervisor.id = advance.supervisor_id
  left join public.field_officers as officer on officer.id = advance.field_officer_id
  left join public.sites as site on site.id = advance.site_id
  order by advance.occurred_at, advance.id;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.complete_advance_sheet_sync(p_advance_id bigint)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  with completed as (
    update public.advance_sheet_sync_outbox
    set synced_at = now(), locked_until = null, last_error = null, updated_at = now()
    where advance_id = p_advance_id and synced_at is null
    returning 1
  )

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_payroll_summary(p_period date, p_actor_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
declare
  period_end date;
  days_in_period integer;
  period_start_timestamp timestamptz;
  period_end_timestamp timestamptz;
  result jsonb;
begin
  if p_actor_id is null or not exists (select 1 from public.admin_users where user_id = p_actor_id) then raise exception 'Administrator access is required'; end if;
  if p_period is null or date_trunc('month', p_period)::date <> p_period then raise exception 'Salary period must be the first day of a month'; end if;
  perform set_config('request.jwt.claim.sub', p_actor_id::text, true);
  period_end := (p_period + interval '1 month')::date;
  days_in_period := period_end - p_period;
  -- Payroll dates are local calendar dates. Convert each midnight explicitly
  -- to the timestamptz boundary and use the next month's start exclusively.
  period_start_timestamp := p_period::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Kolkata';
  period_end_timestamp := period_end::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Kolkata';
  -- Policy: joining_date and employment_end_date are paid days (inclusive).
  -- Monthly gross is prorated by calendar days. Status alone does not stop
  -- accrual; the effective dates control the paid-day range.
  with people as (
    select 'guard'::text as employee_type, id as employee_id, employee_code, full_name, status, joining_date, employment_end_date from public.guards
    union all
    select 'supervisor', id, employee_code, full_name, status, joining_date, employment_end_date from public.supervisors
    union all
    select 'field_officer', id, employee_code, full_name, status, joining_date, employment_end_date from public.field_officers
  ), calculated as (
    select person.*,
      coalesce((select sum((daily.salary / days_in_period)::numeric) from generate_series(
        0,
        least(period_end - 1, coalesce(person.employment_end_date, period_end - 1))
          - greatest(p_period, coalesce(person.joining_date, p_period))
        ) as payroll_day(day_offset)
        cross join lateral (
          select compensation.gross_monthly_salary as salary from public.employee_compensation compensation
          where compensation.employee_type = person.employee_type
            and ((person.employee_type = 'guard' and compensation.guard_id = person.employee_id)
              or (person.employee_type = 'supervisor' and compensation.supervisor_id = person.employee_id)
              or (person.employee_type = 'field_officer' and compensation.field_officer_id = person.employee_id))
            and compensation.effective_from <= greatest(p_period, coalesce(person.joining_date, p_period)) + payroll_day.day_offset
            and (compensation.effective_to is null or compensation.effective_to >= greatest(p_period, coalesce(person.joining_date, p_period)) + payroll_day.day_offset)
          order by compensation.effective_from desc limit 1
        ) daily), 0) as gross_for_period,
      coalesce((select compensation.gross_monthly_salary from public.employee_compensation compensation
        where compensation.employee_type = person.employee_type
          and ((person.employee_type = 'guard' and compensation.guard_id = person.employee_id)
            or (person.employee_type = 'supervisor' and compensation.supervisor_id = person.employee_id)
            or (person.employee_type = 'field_officer' and compensation.field_officer_id = person.employee_id))
          and compensation.effective_from <= period_end - 1
          and (compensation.effective_to is null or compensation.effective_to >= p_period)
        order by compensation.effective_from desc limit 1), 0) as configured_monthly_gross,
      (select compensation.esi_applicable from public.employee_compensation compensation
        where compensation.employee_type = person.employee_type
          and ((person.employee_type = 'guard' and compensation.guard_id = person.employee_id)
            or (person.employee_type = 'supervisor' and compensation.supervisor_id = person.employee_id)
            or (person.employee_type = 'field_officer' and compensation.field_officer_id = person.employee_id))
          and compensation.effective_from <= period_end - 1
          and (compensation.effective_to is null or compensation.effective_to >= p_period)
        order by compensation.effective_from desc limit 1) as esi_applicable,
      (select compensation.esi_contribution_rate from public.employee_compensation compensation
        where compensation.employee_type = person.employee_type
          and ((person.employee_type = 'guard' and compensation.guard_id = person.employee_id)
            or (person.employee_type = 'supervisor' and compensation.supervisor_id = person.employee_id)
            or (person.employee_type = 'field_officer' and compensation.field_officer_id = person.employee_id))
          and compensation.effective_from <= period_end - 1
          and (compensation.effective_to is null or compensation.effective_to >= p_period)
        order by compensation.effective_from desc limit 1) as esi_contribution_rate,
      (select compensation.pf_applicable from public.employee_compensation compensation
        where compensation.employee_type = person.employee_type
          and ((person.employee_type = 'guard' and compensation.guard_id = person.employee_id)
            or (person.employee_type = 'supervisor' and compensation.supervisor_id = person.employee_id)
            or (person.employee_type = 'field_officer' and compensation.field_officer_id = person.employee_id))
          and compensation.effective_from <= period_end - 1
          and (compensation.effective_to is null or compensation.effective_to >= p_period)
        order by compensation.effective_from desc limit 1) as pf_applicable,
      (select compensation.pf_contribution_rate from public.employee_compensation compensation
        where compensation.employee_type = person.employee_type
          and ((person.employee_type = 'guard' and compensation.guard_id = person.employee_id)
            or (person.employee_type = 'supervisor' and compensation.supervisor_id = person.employee_id)
            or (person.employee_type = 'field_officer' and compensation.field_officer_id = person.employee_id))
          and compensation.effective_from <= period_end - 1
          and (compensation.effective_to is null or compensation.effective_to >= p_period)
        order by compensation.effective_from desc limit 1) as pf_contribution_rate,
      coalesce((select sum(case when adjustment.adjustment_type = 'addition' then adjustment.amount else 0 end)
        from public.salary_adjustments adjustment where adjustment.employee_type = person.employee_type
          and ((person.employee_type = 'guard' and adjustment.guard_id = person.employee_id)
            or (person.employee_type = 'supervisor' and adjustment.supervisor_id = person.employee_id)
            or (person.employee_type = 'field_officer' and adjustment.field_officer_id = person.employee_id))
          and adjustment.salary_period = p_period and adjustment.is_approved
          and adjustment.created_at < period_end_timestamp), 0) as approved_additions,
      coalesce((select sum(case when adjustment.adjustment_type = 'deduction' then adjustment.amount else 0 end)
        from public.salary_adjustments adjustment where adjustment.employee_type = person.employee_type
          and ((person.employee_type = 'guard' and adjustment.guard_id = person.employee_id)
            or (person.employee_type = 'supervisor' and adjustment.supervisor_id = person.employee_id)
            or (person.employee_type = 'field_officer' and adjustment.field_officer_id = person.employee_id))
          and adjustment.salary_period = p_period and adjustment.is_approved
          and adjustment.created_at < period_end_timestamp), 0) as approved_deductions,
      coalesce((select sum(advance.amount) from public.advances advance where advance.employee_type = person.employee_type
        and ((person.employee_type = 'guard' and advance.guard_id = person.employee_id)
          or (person.employee_type = 'supervisor' and advance.supervisor_id = person.employee_id)
          or (person.employee_type = 'field_officer' and advance.field_officer_id = person.employee_id))
        and advance.occurred_at >= period_start_timestamp and advance.occurred_at < period_end_timestamp), 0) as advances_given_period,
      coalesce((select sum(recovery.amount) from public.advance_recoveries recovery join public.advances advance on advance.id = recovery.advance_id
        where recovery.salary_period = p_period and recovery.created_at < period_end_timestamp
          and advance.employee_type = person.employee_type
          and ((person.employee_type = 'guard' and advance.guard_id = person.employee_id)
            or (person.employee_type = 'supervisor' and advance.supervisor_id = person.employee_id)
            or (person.employee_type = 'field_officer' and advance.field_officer_id = person.employee_id))), 0) as recovered_period,
      coalesce((select sum(advance.amount + coalesce((select sum(adj.amount_delta) from public.advance_adjustments adj where adj.advance_id = advance.id and adj.created_at < period_end_timestamp), 0)
        - coalesce((select sum(rec.amount) from public.advance_recoveries rec where rec.advance_id = advance.id and rec.salary_period < period_end and rec.created_at < period_end_timestamp), 0))
        from public.advances advance where advance.employee_type = person.employee_type
          and ((person.employee_type = 'guard' and advance.guard_id = person.employee_id)
            or (person.employee_type = 'supervisor' and advance.supervisor_id = person.employee_id)
            or (person.employee_type = 'field_officer' and advance.field_officer_id = person.employee_id))
          and advance.occurred_at < period_end_timestamp), 0) as remaining_advance_balance
    from people person
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'employee_type', employee_type, 'employee_id', employee_id, 'employee_code', employee_code,
    'full_name', full_name, 'status', status, 'joining_date', joining_date, 'employment_end_date', employment_end_date,
    'configured_monthly_gross', configured_monthly_gross, 'gross_for_period', round(gross_for_period, 2),
    'esi_applicable', esi_applicable, 'esi_contribution_rate', esi_contribution_rate,
    'pf_applicable', pf_applicable, 'pf_contribution_rate', pf_contribution_rate,
    'approved_additions', approved_additions, 'approved_deductions', approved_deductions,
    'advances_given_period', advances_given_period, 'recovered_period', recovered_period,
    'remaining_advance_balance', remaining_advance_balance,
    'net_payable_estimate', round(gross_for_period + approved_additions - approved_deductions - recovered_period, 2)
  ) order by full_name), '[]'::jsonb)
  into result from calculated;
  return result;
end;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.import_operations_sites(p_sites jsonb, p_actor_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
declare
  site_record jsonb;
  person_record jsonb;
  site_id_value bigint;
  person_id_value bigint;
  created_row boolean;
  created_sites integer := 0;
  updated_sites integer := 0;
  created_guards integer := 0;
  updated_guards integer := 0;
  created_supervisors integer := 0;
  updated_supervisors integer := 0;
  created_field_officers integer := 0;
  updated_field_officers integer := 0;
  added_relationships integer := 0;
  rows_added integer := 0;
  joining_date_value date;
  employee_status_value text;
  salary_date_value date;
  salary_value numeric(12,2);
  email_value text;
begin
  if p_actor_id is null or not exists (select 1 from public.admin_users where user_id = p_actor_id) then
    raise exception 'Administrator access is required';
  end if;
  perform set_config('request.jwt.claim.sub', p_actor_id::text, true);
  if jsonb_typeof(p_sites) <> 'array' or jsonb_array_length(p_sites) = 0 or jsonb_array_length(p_sites) > 2000 then
    raise exception 'Import must contain between 1 and 2,000 validated sites';
  end if;

  for site_record in select value from jsonb_array_elements(p_sites) loop
    insert into public.sites (
      site_code, title, phone_numbers, total_salary, service_taken, given_emails, status,
      security_guard_monthly_billing, aso_monthly_billing, payroll_effective_date,
      esi_applicable, esi_contribution_rate, pf_applicable, pf_contribution_rate, payroll_notes
    ) values (
      upper(btrim(site_record ->> 'site_code')), btrim(site_record ->> 'title'),
      coalesce(site_record ->> 'phone_numbers', ''), coalesce(site_record ->> 'total_salary', ''),
      coalesce(site_record ->> 'service_taken', 'SECURITY GUARD'), coalesce(site_record ->> 'given_emails', ''),
      coalesce(site_record ->> 'status', 'active'),
      nullif(site_record ->> 'security_guard_monthly_billing', '')::numeric,
      nullif(site_record ->> 'aso_monthly_billing', '')::numeric,
      nullif(site_record ->> 'payroll_effective_date', '')::date,
      nullif(site_record ->> 'esi_applicable', '')::boolean,
      nullif(site_record ->> 'esi_contribution_rate', '')::numeric,
      nullif(site_record ->> 'pf_applicable', '')::boolean,
      nullif(site_record ->> 'pf_contribution_rate', '')::numeric,
      coalesce(site_record ->> 'payroll_notes', '')
    ) on conflict (lower(site_code)) where site_code is not null and btrim(site_code) <> ''
    do update set
      title = excluded.title,
      phone_numbers = excluded.phone_numbers,
      total_salary = excluded.total_salary,
      service_taken = excluded.service_taken,
      given_emails = excluded.given_emails,
      status = excluded.status,
      security_guard_monthly_billing = excluded.security_guard_monthly_billing,
      aso_monthly_billing = excluded.aso_monthly_billing,
      payroll_effective_date = excluded.payroll_effective_date,
      esi_applicable = excluded.esi_applicable,
      esi_contribution_rate = excluded.esi_contribution_rate,
      pf_applicable = excluded.pf_applicable,
      pf_contribution_rate = excluded.pf_contribution_rate,
      payroll_notes = excluded.payroll_notes,
      updated_at = now()
    returning id, (xmax = 0) into site_id_value, created_row;
    if created_row then created_sites := created_sites + 1; else updated_sites := updated_sites + 1; end if;

    for person_record in select value from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(site_record -> 'guards', '[]'::jsonb)) loop
      joining_date_value := nullif(person_record ->> 'joining_date', '')::date;
      employee_status_value := lower(btrim(coalesce(nullif(person_record ->> 'status', ''), 'active')));
      email_value := nullif(lower(btrim(person_record ->> 'email')), '');
      insert into public.guards(employee_code, full_name, phone, email, designation, status, joining_date, site_id, updated_at)
      values (
        coalesce(nullif(upper(btrim(person_record ->> 'employee_code')), ''), 'GSS-GRD-' || upper(substr(replace(gen_random_uuid()::text, '-', ''), 1, 12))), btrim(person_record ->> 'full_name'),
        btrim(person_record ->> 'phone'), email_value, coalesce(nullif(btrim(person_record ->> 'designation'), ''), 'Security Guard'),
        employee_status_value, joining_date_value, null, now()
      ) on conflict (phone_normalized) where phone_normalized <> ''
      do update set full_name = excluded.full_name, email = excluded.email, designation = excluded.designation,
        status = excluded.status, joining_date = coalesce(excluded.joining_date, guards.joining_date), updated_at = now()
      returning id, (xmax = 0) into person_id_value, created_row;
      if created_row then created_guards := created_guards + 1; else updated_guards := updated_guards + 1; end if;
      if employee_status_value in ('inactive', 'relieved') then
        update public.guard_site_assignments set valid_to = current_date
        where guard_id = person_id_value and valid_to is null;
      else
        insert into public.guard_site_assignments(guard_id, site_id, valid_from, created_by)
        values (person_id_value, site_id_value, coalesce(joining_date_value, current_date), p_actor_id)
        on conflict (guard_id, site_id) where valid_to is null do nothing;
        get diagnostics rows_added = row_count;
        added_relationships := added_relationships + rows_added;
      end if;
      salary_value := nullif(person_record ->> 'gross_monthly_salary', '')::numeric;
      if salary_value is not null then
        salary_date_value := coalesce(nullif(person_record ->> 'salary_effective_from', '')::date, joining_date_value, current_date);
        insert into public.employee_compensation(employee_type, guard_id, gross_monthly_salary, effective_from, notes, created_by)
        values ('guard', person_id_value, salary_value, salary_date_value, 'Imported through site spreadsheet', p_actor_id)
        on conflict (guard_id, effective_from) where guard_id is not null do update set
          gross_monthly_salary = excluded.gross_monthly_salary, notes = excluded.notes;
      end if;
    end loop;

    for person_record in select value from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(site_record -> 'supervisors', '[]'::jsonb)) loop
      joining_date_value := nullif(person_record ->> 'joining_date', '')::date;
      employee_status_value := lower(btrim(coalesce(nullif(person_record ->> 'status', ''), 'active')));
      email_value := nullif(lower(btrim(person_record ->> 'email')), '');
      insert into public.supervisors(employee_code, full_name, phone, email, designation, status, joining_date, updated_at)
      values (
        coalesce(nullif(upper(btrim(person_record ->> 'employee_code')), ''), 'GSS-SUP-' || upper(substr(replace(gen_random_uuid()::text, '-', ''), 1, 12))),
        btrim(person_record ->> 'full_name'), btrim(person_record ->> 'phone'), email_value,
        coalesce(nullif(btrim(person_record ->> 'designation'), ''), 'Supervisor'),
        employee_status_value, joining_date_value, now()
      ) on conflict (phone_normalized) where phone_normalized <> ''
      do update set full_name = excluded.full_name, email = excluded.email, designation = excluded.designation,
        status = excluded.status, joining_date = coalesce(excluded.joining_date, supervisors.joining_date), updated_at = now()
      returning id, (xmax = 0) into person_id_value, created_row;
      if created_row then created_supervisors := created_supervisors + 1; else updated_supervisors := updated_supervisors + 1; end if;
      if employee_status_value in ('inactive', 'relieved') then
        update public.supervisor_site_assignments set valid_to = current_date
        where supervisor_id = person_id_value and valid_to is null;
        update public.supervisor_reporting set valid_to = current_date
        where supervisor_id = person_id_value and valid_to is null;
      else
        insert into public.supervisor_site_assignments(supervisor_id, site_id, valid_from, created_by)
        values (person_id_value, site_id_value, coalesce(joining_date_value, current_date), p_actor_id)
        on conflict (supervisor_id, site_id) where valid_to is null do nothing;
        get diagnostics rows_added = row_count;
        added_relationships := added_relationships + rows_added;
      end if;
      salary_value := nullif(person_record ->> 'gross_monthly_salary', '')::numeric;
      if salary_value is not null then
        salary_date_value := coalesce(nullif(person_record ->> 'salary_effective_from', '')::date, joining_date_value, current_date);
        insert into public.employee_compensation(employee_type, supervisor_id, gross_monthly_salary, effective_from, notes, created_by)
        values ('supervisor', person_id_value, salary_value, salary_date_value, 'Imported through site spreadsheet', p_actor_id)
        on conflict (supervisor_id, effective_from) where supervisor_id is not null do update set
          gross_monthly_salary = excluded.gross_monthly_salary, notes = excluded.notes;
      end if;
    end loop;

    for person_record in select value from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(site_record -> 'field_officers', '[]'::jsonb)) loop
      joining_date_value := nullif(person_record ->> 'joining_date', '')::date;
      employee_status_value := lower(btrim(coalesce(nullif(person_record ->> 'status', ''), 'active')));
      email_value := nullif(lower(btrim(person_record ->> 'email')), '');
      insert into public.field_officers(employee_code, full_name, phone, email, designation, status, joining_date, updated_at)
      values (
        coalesce(nullif(upper(btrim(person_record ->> 'employee_code')), ''), 'GSS-FO-' || upper(substr(replace(gen_random_uuid()::text, '-', ''), 1, 12))),
        btrim(person_record ->> 'full_name'), btrim(person_record ->> 'phone'), email_value,
        coalesce(nullif(btrim(person_record ->> 'designation'), ''), 'Field Officer'),
        employee_status_value, joining_date_value, now()
      ) on conflict (phone_normalized) where phone_normalized <> ''
      do update set full_name = excluded.full_name, email = excluded.email, designation = excluded.designation,
        status = excluded.status, joining_date = coalesce(excluded.joining_date, field_officers.joining_date), updated_at = now()
      returning id, (xmax = 0) into person_id_value, created_row;
      if created_row then created_field_officers := created_field_officers + 1; else updated_field_officers := updated_field_officers + 1; end if;
      if employee_status_value in ('inactive', 'relieved') then
        update public.field_officer_site_assignments set valid_to = current_date
        where field_officer_id = person_id_value and valid_to is null;
        update public.supervisor_reporting set valid_to = current_date
        where field_officer_id = person_id_value and valid_to is null;
      else
        insert into public.field_officer_site_assignments(field_officer_id, site_id, valid_from, created_by)
        values (person_id_value, site_id_value, coalesce(joining_date_value, current_date), p_actor_id)
        on conflict (field_officer_id, site_id) where valid_to is null do nothing;
        get diagnostics rows_added = row_count;
        added_relationships := added_relationships + rows_added;
      end if;
      salary_value := nullif(person_record ->> 'gross_monthly_salary', '')::numeric;
      if salary_value is not null then
        salary_date_value := coalesce(nullif(person_record ->> 'salary_effective_from', '')::date, joining_date_value, current_date);
        insert into public.employee_compensation(employee_type, field_officer_id, gross_monthly_salary, effective_from, notes, created_by)
        values ('field_officer', person_id_value, salary_value, salary_date_value, 'Imported through site spreadsheet', p_actor_id)
        on conflict (field_officer_id, effective_from) where field_officer_id is not null do update set
          gross_monthly_salary = excluded.gross_monthly_salary, notes = excluded.notes;
      end if;
    end loop;
  end loop;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'sites_created', created_sites, 'sites_updated', updated_sites,
    'guards_created', created_guards, 'guards_updated', updated_guards,
    'supervisors_created', created_supervisors, 'supervisors_updated', updated_supervisors,
    'field_officers_created', created_field_officers, 'field_officers_updated', updated_field_officers,
    'relationships_added', added_relationships, 'skipped', 0, 'failed', 0
  );
end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_advance(p_advance jsonb, p_actor_id uuid)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
declare
  advance_id_value bigint;
  type_value text := p_advance ->> 'employee_type';
  guard_id_value bigint := nullif(p_advance ->> 'guard_id', '')::bigint;
  supervisor_id_value bigint := nullif(p_advance ->> 'supervisor_id', '')::bigint;
  officer_id_value bigint := nullif(p_advance ->> 'field_officer_id', '')::bigint;
  site_id_value bigint := nullif(p_advance ->> 'site_id', '')::bigint;
  source_value text := coalesce(nullif(p_advance ->> 'source', ''), 'dashboard');
  external_ref text := nullif(btrim(p_advance ->> 'external_reference'), '');
begin
  if p_actor_id is null or not exists (select 1 from public.admin_users where user_id = p_actor_id) then raise exception 'Administrator access is required'; end if;
  if type_value not in ('guard', 'supervisor', 'field_officer') then raise exception 'Employee type is invalid'; end if;
  if (type_value = 'guard' and (guard_id_value is null or supervisor_id_value is not null or officer_id_value is not null))
    or (type_value = 'supervisor' and (supervisor_id_value is null or guard_id_value is not null or officer_id_value is not null))
    or (type_value = 'field_officer' and (officer_id_value is null or guard_id_value is not null or supervisor_id_value is not null)) then raise exception 'Advance must reference exactly one employee of the selected type'; end if;
  if site_id_value is not null then
    if type_value = 'guard' and not exists (select 1 from public.guard_site_assignments where guard_id = guard_id_value and site_id = site_id_value and valid_to is null) then raise exception 'Guard is not assigned to the selected site'; end if;
    if type_value = 'supervisor' and not exists (select 1 from public.supervisor_site_assignments where supervisor_id = supervisor_id_value and site_id = site_id_value and valid_to is null) then raise exception 'Supervisor is not assigned to the selected site'; end if;
    if type_value = 'field_officer' and not exists (select 1 from public.field_officer_site_assignments where field_officer_id = officer_id_value and site_id = site_id_value and valid_to is null) then raise exception 'Field officer is not assigned to the selected site'; end if;
  end if;
  if source_value not in ('dashboard', 'telegram', 'api') then raise exception 'Advance source is invalid'; end if;
  perform set_config('request.jwt.claim.sub', p_actor_id::text, true);
  perform set_config(
    'operations.google_sheets_sync_enabled',
    case when lower(coalesce(p_advance ->> 'enqueue_sheet_sync', 'false')) = 'true' then 'true' else 'false' end,
    true
  );
  insert into public.advances(employee_type, guard_id, supervisor_id, field_officer_id, site_id, amount, occurred_at, payment_mode, description, source, external_reference, recorded_by)
  values (type_value, guard_id_value, supervisor_id_value, officer_id_value, site_id_value,
    nullif(p_advance ->> 'amount', '')::numeric, coalesce(nullif(p_advance ->> 'occurred_at', '')::timestamptz, now()),
    coalesce(p_advance ->> 'payment_mode', ''), coalesce(p_advance ->> 'description', ''), source_value, external_ref, p_actor_id)
  on conflict (source, external_reference) where external_reference is not null and btrim(external_reference) <> '' do nothing
  returning id into advance_id_value;
  if advance_id_value is null and external_ref is not null then
    select id into advance_id_value from public.advances where source = source_value and external_reference = external_ref;
  end if;
  return advance_id_value;
end;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.retry_advance_sheet_sync(p_advance_id bigint, p_error_code text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
declare updated_count integer;
begin
  update public.advance_sheet_sync_outbox
  set next_attempt_at = now() + make_interval(mins => least(360, power(2, least(attempts, 8))::integer)),
      locked_until = null,
      last_error = case when p_error_code ~ '^[a-z0-9_]{1,64}$' then p_error_code else 'sync_failed' end,
      updated_at = now()
  where advance_id = p_advance_id and synced_at is null;
  get diagnostics updated_count = row_count;
  return updated_count > 0;
end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rls_auto_enable()
 RETURNS event_trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  cmd record;
BEGIN
  FOR cmd IN
    SELECT *
    FROM pg_event_trigger_ddl_commands()
    WHERE command_tag IN ('CREATE TABLE', 'CREATE TABLE AS', 'SELECT INTO')
      AND object_type IN ('table','partitioned table')
  LOOP
     IF cmd.schema_name IS NOT NULL AND cmd.schema_name IN ('public') AND cmd.schema_name NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema') AND cmd.schema_name NOT LIKE 'pg_toast%' AND cmd.schema_name NOT LIKE 'pg_temp%' THEN
      BEGIN
        EXECUTE format('alter table if exists %s enable row level security', cmd.object_identity);
        RAISE LOG 'rls_auto_enable: enabled RLS on %', cmd.object_identity;
      EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
          RAISE LOG 'rls_auto_enable: failed to enable RLS on %', cmd.object_identity;
      END;
     ELSE
        RAISE LOG 'rls_auto_enable: skip % (either system schema or not in enforced list: %.)', cmd.object_identity, cmd.schema_name;
     END IF;
  END LOOP;
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.save_employee_profile(p_employee_type text, p_employee_id bigint, p_person jsonb, p_site_ids bigint[], p_reporting_ids bigint[], p_actor_id uuid)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
declare
  person_id bigint;
  effective_date date;
  salary_amount_value numeric(12,2);
  person_code text;
  requested_sites bigint[] := coalesce(p_site_ids, array[]::bigint[]);
  requested_reports bigint[] := coalesce(p_reporting_ids, array[]::bigint[]);
begin
  if p_actor_id is null or not exists (select 1 from public.admin_users where user_id = p_actor_id) then
    raise exception 'Administrator access is required';
  end if;
  if p_employee_type not in ('supervisor', 'field_officer') then raise exception 'Employee type is invalid'; end if;
  if length(btrim(coalesce(p_person ->> 'full_name', ''))) not between 1 and 160 then raise exception 'A name of 1 to 160 characters is required'; end if;
  if length(regexp_replace(coalesce(p_person ->> 'phone', ''), '\D', '', 'g')) not between 10 and 15 then raise exception 'A valid phone number is required'; end if;
  if coalesce(p_person ->> 'status', 'active') not in ('active', 'inactive', 'on_leave', 'relieved') then raise exception 'Employee status is invalid'; end if;
  if cardinality(requested_sites) <> (select count(distinct item.id) from unnest(requested_sites) as item(id)) then raise exception 'Site assignments contain duplicates'; end if;
  if cardinality(requested_reports) <> (select count(distinct item.id) from unnest(requested_reports) as item(id)) then raise exception 'Reporting assignments contain duplicates'; end if;
  if exists (select 1 from unnest(requested_sites) as item(id) where not exists (select 1 from public.sites where id = item.id)) then raise exception 'A selected site was not found'; end if;
  if p_employee_type = 'supervisor' and exists (select 1 from unnest(requested_reports) as item(id) where not exists (select 1 from public.field_officers where id = item.id)) then raise exception 'A selected field officer was not found'; end if;
  if p_employee_type = 'field_officer' and exists (select 1 from unnest(requested_reports) as item(id) where not exists (select 1 from public.supervisors where id = item.id)) then raise exception 'A selected supervisor was not found'; end if;
  perform set_config('request.jwt.claim.sub', p_actor_id::text, true);
  if coalesce(p_person ->> 'status', 'active') in ('inactive', 'relieved') then
    requested_sites := array[]::bigint[];
    requested_reports := array[]::bigint[];
  end if;

  if p_employee_type = 'supervisor' then
    if p_employee_id is null then
      insert into public.supervisors(employee_code, full_name, phone, email, designation, status, joining_date, employment_end_date, date_of_birth, residential_address, photo_storage_path, updated_at)
      values (
        coalesce(nullif(upper(btrim(p_person ->> 'employee_code')), ''), 'GSS-SUP-' || upper(substr(replace(gen_random_uuid()::text, '-', ''), 1, 12))),
        btrim(p_person ->> 'full_name'), btrim(p_person ->> 'phone'), nullif(lower(btrim(p_person ->> 'email')), ''),
        coalesce(nullif(btrim(p_person ->> 'designation'), ''), 'Supervisor'), coalesce(p_person ->> 'status', 'active'),
        nullif(p_person ->> 'joining_date', '')::date, nullif(p_person ->> 'employment_end_date', '')::date,
        nullif(p_person ->> 'date_of_birth', '')::date, nullif(p_person ->> 'residential_address', ''),
        nullif(p_person ->> 'photo_storage_path', ''), now()
      ) returning id into person_id;
    else
      update public.supervisors set
        employee_code = coalesce(nullif(upper(btrim(p_person ->> 'employee_code')), ''), employee_code),
        full_name = btrim(p_person ->> 'full_name'), phone = btrim(p_person ->> 'phone'), email = nullif(lower(btrim(p_person ->> 'email')), ''),
        designation = coalesce(nullif(btrim(p_person ->> 'designation'), ''), 'Supervisor'), status = coalesce(p_person ->> 'status', 'active'),
        joining_date = nullif(p_person ->> 'joining_date', '')::date, employment_end_date = nullif(p_person ->> 'employment_end_date', '')::date,
        date_of_birth = nullif(p_person ->> 'date_of_birth', '')::date, residential_address = nullif(p_person ->> 'residential_address', ''),
        photo_storage_path = nullif(p_person ->> 'photo_storage_path', ''), updated_at = now()
      where id = p_employee_id returning id into person_id;
      if person_id is null then raise exception 'Supervisor was not found'; end if;
    end if;

    update public.supervisor_site_assignments set valid_to = current_date
    where supervisor_id = person_id and valid_to is null and not (site_id = any(requested_sites));
    insert into public.supervisor_site_assignments(supervisor_id, site_id, valid_from, created_by)
    select person_id, requested.id, current_date, p_actor_id from unnest(requested_sites) as requested(id)
    where not exists (select 1 from public.supervisor_site_assignments a where a.supervisor_id = person_id and a.site_id = requested.id and a.valid_to is null);

    update public.supervisor_reporting set valid_to = current_date
    where supervisor_id = person_id and valid_to is null and not (field_officer_id = any(requested_reports));
    insert into public.supervisor_reporting(supervisor_id, field_officer_id, valid_from, created_by)
    select person_id, requested.id, current_date, p_actor_id from unnest(requested_reports) as requested(id)
    where not exists (select 1 from public.supervisor_reporting r where r.supervisor_id = person_id and r.field_officer_id = requested.id and r.valid_to is null);
  else
    if p_employee_id is null then
      insert into public.field_officers(employee_code, full_name, phone, email, designation, status, joining_date, employment_end_date, date_of_birth, residential_address, photo_storage_path, updated_at)
      values (
        coalesce(nullif(upper(btrim(p_person ->> 'employee_code')), ''), 'GSS-FO-' || upper(substr(replace(gen_random_uuid()::text, '-', ''), 1, 12))),
        btrim(p_person ->> 'full_name'), btrim(p_person ->> 'phone'), nullif(lower(btrim(p_person ->> 'email')), ''),
        coalesce(nullif(btrim(p_person ->> 'designation'), ''), 'Field Officer'), coalesce(p_person ->> 'status', 'active'),
        nullif(p_person ->> 'joining_date', '')::date, nullif(p_person ->> 'employment_end_date', '')::date,
        nullif(p_person ->> 'date_of_birth', '')::date, nullif(p_person ->> 'residential_address', ''),
        nullif(p_person ->> 'photo_storage_path', ''), now()
      ) returning id into person_id;
    else
      update public.field_officers set
        employee_code = coalesce(nullif(upper(btrim(p_person ->> 'employee_code')), ''), employee_code),
        full_name = btrim(p_person ->> 'full_name'), phone = btrim(p_person ->> 'phone'), email = nullif(lower(btrim(p_person ->> 'email')), ''),
        designation = coalesce(nullif(btrim(p_person ->> 'designation'), ''), 'Field Officer'), status = coalesce(p_person ->> 'status', 'active'),
        joining_date = nullif(p_person ->> 'joining_date', '')::date, employment_end_date = nullif(p_person ->> 'employment_end_date', '')::date,
        date_of_birth = nullif(p_person ->> 'date_of_birth', '')::date, residential_address = nullif(p_person ->> 'residential_address', ''),
        photo_storage_path = nullif(p_person ->> 'photo_storage_path', ''), updated_at = now()
      where id = p_employee_id returning id into person_id;
      if person_id is null then raise exception 'Field officer was not found'; end if;
    end if;

    update public.field_officer_site_assignments set valid_to = current_date
    where field_officer_id = person_id and valid_to is null and not (site_id = any(requested_sites));
    insert into public.field_officer_site_assignments(field_officer_id, site_id, valid_from, created_by)
    select person_id, requested.id, current_date, p_actor_id from unnest(requested_sites) as requested(id)
    where not exists (select 1 from public.field_officer_site_assignments a where a.field_officer_id = person_id and a.site_id = requested.id and a.valid_to is null);

    update public.supervisor_reporting set valid_to = current_date
    where field_officer_id = person_id and valid_to is null and not (supervisor_id = any(requested_reports));
    insert into public.supervisor_reporting(supervisor_id, field_officer_id, valid_from, created_by)
    select requested.id, person_id, current_date, p_actor_id from unnest(requested_reports) as requested(id)
    where not exists (select 1 from public.supervisor_reporting r where r.supervisor_id = requested.id and r.field_officer_id = person_id and r.valid_to is null);
  end if;

  salary_amount_value := nullif(p_person ->> 'gross_monthly_salary', '')::numeric;
  if salary_amount_value is not null then
    effective_date := coalesce(nullif(p_person ->> 'salary_effective_from', '')::date, current_date);
    if p_employee_type = 'supervisor' then
      if exists (select 1 from public.employee_compensation c where c.supervisor_id = person_id and c.effective_from > effective_date) then raise exception 'Use the latest compensation effective date or edit its existing record'; end if;
      update public.employee_compensation set effective_to = effective_date - 1
      where supervisor_id = person_id and effective_from < effective_date and effective_to is null;
      insert into public.employee_compensation(employee_type, supervisor_id, gross_monthly_salary, effective_from, esi_applicable, esi_contribution_rate, pf_applicable, pf_contribution_rate, notes, created_by)
      values ('supervisor', person_id, salary_amount_value, effective_date, nullif(p_person ->> 'esi_applicable', '')::boolean,
        nullif(p_person ->> 'esi_contribution_rate', '')::numeric, nullif(p_person ->> 'pf_applicable', '')::boolean,
        nullif(p_person ->> 'pf_contribution_rate', '')::numeric, coalesce(p_person ->> 'salary_notes', ''), p_actor_id)
      on conflict (supervisor_id, effective_from) where supervisor_id is not null do update set
        gross_monthly_salary = excluded.gross_monthly_salary, esi_applicable = excluded.esi_applicable,
        esi_contribution_rate = excluded.esi_contribution_rate, pf_applicable = excluded.pf_applicable,
        pf_contribution_rate = excluded.pf_contribution_rate, notes = excluded.notes;
    else
      if exists (select 1 from public.employee_compensation c where c.field_officer_id = person_id and c.effective_from > effective_date) then raise exception 'Use the latest compensation effective date or edit its existing record'; end if;
      update public.employee_compensation set effective_to = effective_date - 1
      where field_officer_id = person_id and effective_from < effective_date and effective_to is null;
      insert into public.employee_compensation(employee_type, field_officer_id, gross_monthly_salary, effective_from, esi_applicable, esi_contribution_rate, pf_applicable, pf_contribution_rate, notes, created_by)
      values ('field_officer', person_id, salary_amount_value, effective_date, nullif(p_person ->> 'esi_applicable', '')::boolean,
        nullif(p_person ->> 'esi_contribution_rate', '')::numeric, nullif(p_person ->> 'pf_applicable', '')::boolean,
        nullif(p_person ->> 'pf_contribution_rate', '')::numeric, coalesce(p_person ->> 'salary_notes', ''), p_actor_id)
      on conflict (field_officer_id, effective_from) where field_officer_id is not null do update set
        gross_monthly_salary = excluded.gross_monthly_salary, esi_applicable = excluded.esi_applicable,
        esi_contribution_rate = excluded.esi_contribution_rate, pf_applicable = excluded.pf_applicable,
        pf_contribution_rate = excluded.pf_contribution_rate, notes = excluded.notes;
    end if;
  end if;
  return person_id;
end;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.save_guard_profile(p_guard_id bigint, p_person jsonb, p_site_ids bigint[], p_actor_id uuid)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
declare
  guard_id_value bigint;
  site_ids_value bigint[] := coalesce(p_site_ids, array[]::bigint[]);
  salary_amount_value numeric(12,2) := nullif(p_person ->> 'salary_amount', '')::numeric;
  salary_frequency_value text := coalesce(nullif(p_person ->> 'salary_frequency', ''), 'monthly');
  salary_date_value date;
begin
  if p_actor_id is null or not exists (select 1 from public.admin_users where user_id = p_actor_id) then raise exception 'Administrator access is required'; end if;
  if length(btrim(coalesce(p_person ->> 'full_name', ''))) not between 1 and 160 then raise exception 'A guard name of 1 to 160 characters is required'; end if;
  if length(regexp_replace(coalesce(p_person ->> 'phone', ''), '\D', '', 'g')) not between 10 and 15 then raise exception 'A valid guard phone is required'; end if;
  if coalesce(p_person ->> 'status', 'active') not in ('active', 'inactive', 'on_leave', 'relieved') then raise exception 'Guard status is invalid'; end if;
  if salary_frequency_value not in ('monthly', 'daily') then raise exception 'Salary frequency is invalid'; end if;
  if cardinality(site_ids_value) <> (select count(distinct item.id) from unnest(site_ids_value) as item(id)) then raise exception 'Site assignments contain duplicates'; end if;
  if exists (select 1 from unnest(site_ids_value) as item(id) where not exists (select 1 from public.sites where id = item.id)) then raise exception 'A selected site was not found'; end if;
  if coalesce(p_person ->> 'status', 'active') in ('inactive', 'relieved') then site_ids_value := array[]::bigint[]; end if;
  perform set_config('request.jwt.claim.sub', p_actor_id::text, true);

  if p_guard_id is null then
    insert into public.guards(employee_code, full_name, phone, email, designation, status, joining_date,
      employment_end_date, date_of_birth, residential_address, photo_storage_path, salary_amount,
      salary_frequency, salary_effective_date, salary_notes, updated_at)
    values (coalesce(nullif(upper(btrim(p_person ->> 'employee_code')), ''), 'GSS-GRD-' || upper(substr(replace(gen_random_uuid()::text, '-', ''), 1, 12))),
      btrim(p_person ->> 'full_name'), btrim(p_person ->> 'phone'), nullif(lower(btrim(p_person ->> 'email')), ''),
      coalesce(nullif(btrim(p_person ->> 'designation'), ''), 'Security Guard'), coalesce(p_person ->> 'status', 'active'),
      nullif(p_person ->> 'joining_date', '')::date, nullif(p_person ->> 'employment_end_date', '')::date,
      nullif(p_person ->> 'date_of_birth', '')::date, nullif(p_person ->> 'residential_address', ''),
      nullif(p_person ->> 'photo_storage_path', ''), salary_amount_value, salary_frequency_value,
      nullif(p_person ->> 'salary_effective_date', '')::date, coalesce(p_person ->> 'salary_notes', ''), now())
    returning id into guard_id_value;
  else
    update public.guards set
      employee_code = coalesce(nullif(upper(btrim(p_person ->> 'employee_code')), ''), employee_code),
      full_name = btrim(p_person ->> 'full_name'), phone = btrim(p_person ->> 'phone'),
      email = nullif(lower(btrim(p_person ->> 'email')), ''),
      designation = coalesce(nullif(btrim(p_person ->> 'designation'), ''), 'Security Guard'),
      status = coalesce(p_person ->> 'status', 'active'), joining_date = nullif(p_person ->> 'joining_date', '')::date,
      employment_end_date = nullif(p_person ->> 'employment_end_date', '')::date,
      date_of_birth = nullif(p_person ->> 'date_of_birth', '')::date,
      residential_address = nullif(p_person ->> 'residential_address', ''),
      photo_storage_path = nullif(p_person ->> 'photo_storage_path', ''), salary_amount = salary_amount_value,
      salary_frequency = salary_frequency_value, salary_effective_date = nullif(p_person ->> 'salary_effective_date', '')::date,
      salary_notes = coalesce(p_person ->> 'salary_notes', ''), updated_at = now()
    where id = p_guard_id returning id into guard_id_value;
    if guard_id_value is null then raise exception 'Guard was not found'; end if;
  end if;

  update public.guard_site_assignments set valid_to = current_date
  where guard_id = guard_id_value and valid_to is null and not (site_id = any(site_ids_value));
  insert into public.guard_site_assignments(guard_id, site_id, valid_from, created_by)
  select guard_id_value, requested.id, current_date, p_actor_id from unnest(site_ids_value) as requested(id)
  where not exists (select 1 from public.guard_site_assignments a where a.guard_id = guard_id_value and a.site_id = requested.id and a.valid_to is null);

  salary_date_value := coalesce(nullif(p_person ->> 'salary_effective_date', '')::date, current_date);
  if exists (select 1 from public.employee_compensation c where c.guard_id = guard_id_value and c.effective_from > salary_date_value) then
    raise exception 'Use the latest compensation effective date or edit its existing record';
  end if;
  update public.employee_compensation set effective_to = salary_date_value - 1
    where guard_id = guard_id_value and effective_from < salary_date_value and effective_to is null;
  if salary_amount_value is not null and salary_frequency_value = 'monthly' then
    insert into public.employee_compensation(employee_type, guard_id, gross_monthly_salary, effective_from, notes, created_by)
      values ('guard', guard_id_value, salary_amount_value, salary_date_value, coalesce(p_person ->> 'salary_notes', ''), p_actor_id)
      on conflict (guard_id, effective_from) where guard_id is not null do update
        set gross_monthly_salary = excluded.gross_monthly_salary, notes = excluded.notes;
  else
    -- A daily rate is stored on the guard profile but the application does not
    -- track attendance, so it must not leave an earlier monthly salary active.
    -- The audit trigger retains the removed effective-date row for review.
    delete from public.employee_compensation
      where guard_id = guard_id_value and effective_from = salary_date_value;
  end if;
  return guard_id_value;
end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.save_site_with_assignments(p_site jsonb, p_site_id bigint, p_guard_ids bigint[], p_supervisor_ids bigint[], p_field_officer_ids bigint[], p_actor_id uuid)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
declare
  saved_site_id bigint;
  site_title text := nullif(btrim(p_site ->> 'title'), '');
  site_code_value text := nullif(upper(btrim(p_site ->> 'site_code')), '');
begin
  if p_actor_id is null or not exists (select 1 from public.admin_users where user_id = p_actor_id) then
    raise exception 'Administrator access is required';
  end if;
  perform set_config('request.jwt.claim.sub', p_actor_id::text, true);
  if site_title is null or length(site_title) > 160 then raise exception 'A site name of 1 to 160 characters is required'; end if;
  if site_code_value is null or length(site_code_value) > 64 or site_code_value !~ '^[A-Z0-9_-]+$' then
    raise exception 'A stable site code containing letters, numbers, hyphens, or underscores is required';
  end if;
  if coalesce(p_site ->> 'status', 'active') not in ('active', 'inactive') then raise exception 'Invalid site status'; end if;
  if coalesce(p_site ->> 'service_taken', 'SECURITY GUARD') not in ('SECURITY GUARD', 'ASO', 'BOTH') then raise exception 'Invalid service type'; end if;
  if p_site_id is not null then
    update public.sites set
      site_code = site_code_value,
      title = site_title,
      phone_numbers = coalesce(p_site ->> 'phone_numbers', ''),
      total_salary = coalesce(p_site ->> 'total_salary', ''),
      service_taken = coalesce(p_site ->> 'service_taken', 'SECURITY GUARD'),
      given_emails = coalesce(p_site ->> 'given_emails', ''),
      status = coalesce(p_site ->> 'status', 'active'),
      security_guard_monthly_billing = nullif(p_site ->> 'security_guard_monthly_billing', '')::numeric,
      aso_monthly_billing = nullif(p_site ->> 'aso_monthly_billing', '')::numeric,
      payroll_effective_date = nullif(p_site ->> 'payroll_effective_date', '')::date,
      esi_applicable = nullif(p_site ->> 'esi_applicable', '')::boolean,
      esi_contribution_rate = nullif(p_site ->> 'esi_contribution_rate', '')::numeric,
      pf_applicable = nullif(p_site ->> 'pf_applicable', '')::boolean,
      pf_contribution_rate = nullif(p_site ->> 'pf_contribution_rate', '')::numeric,
      payroll_notes = coalesce(p_site ->> 'payroll_notes', ''),
      updated_at = now()
    where id = p_site_id returning id into saved_site_id;
    if saved_site_id is null then raise exception 'Site was not found'; end if;
  else
    insert into public.sites (
      site_code, title, phone_numbers, total_salary, service_taken, given_emails, status,
      security_guard_monthly_billing, aso_monthly_billing, payroll_effective_date,
      esi_applicable, esi_contribution_rate, pf_applicable, pf_contribution_rate, payroll_notes
    ) values (
      site_code_value, site_title, coalesce(p_site ->> 'phone_numbers', ''),
      coalesce(p_site ->> 'total_salary', ''), coalesce(p_site ->> 'service_taken', 'SECURITY GUARD'),
      coalesce(p_site ->> 'given_emails', ''), coalesce(p_site ->> 'status', 'active'),
      nullif(p_site ->> 'security_guard_monthly_billing', '')::numeric,
      nullif(p_site ->> 'aso_monthly_billing', '')::numeric,
      nullif(p_site ->> 'payroll_effective_date', '')::date,
      nullif(p_site ->> 'esi_applicable', '')::boolean,
      nullif(p_site ->> 'esi_contribution_rate', '')::numeric,
      nullif(p_site ->> 'pf_applicable', '')::boolean,
      nullif(p_site ->> 'pf_contribution_rate', '')::numeric,
      coalesce(p_site ->> 'payroll_notes', '')
    ) returning id into saved_site_id;
  end if;

  update public.guard_site_assignments set valid_to = current_date
  where site_id = saved_site_id and valid_to is null
    and not (guard_id = any(coalesce(p_guard_ids, array[]::bigint[])));
  update public.supervisor_site_assignments set valid_to = current_date
  where site_id = saved_site_id and valid_to is null
    and not (supervisor_id = any(coalesce(p_supervisor_ids, array[]::bigint[])));
  update public.field_officer_site_assignments set valid_to = current_date
  where site_id = saved_site_id and valid_to is null
    and not (field_officer_id = any(coalesce(p_field_officer_ids, array[]::bigint[])));

  insert into public.guard_site_assignments(guard_id, site_id, valid_from, created_by)
  select requested_id, saved_site_id, current_date, p_actor_id
  from (select distinct unnest(coalesce(p_guard_ids, array[]::bigint[])) as requested_id) requested
  where exists (select 1 from public.guards where id = requested.requested_id)
    and not exists (select 1 from public.guard_site_assignments a where a.guard_id = requested.requested_id and a.site_id = saved_site_id and a.valid_to is null);
  if cardinality(coalesce(p_guard_ids, array[]::bigint[])) <> (select count(distinct item.id) from unnest(coalesce(p_guard_ids, array[]::bigint[])) as item(id)) then raise exception 'Guard assignment contains duplicate IDs'; end if;
  if exists (select 1 from unnest(coalesce(p_guard_ids, array[]::bigint[])) as item(id) where not exists (select 1 from public.guards where guards.id = item.id)) then raise exception 'A selected guard was not found'; end if;

  insert into public.supervisor_site_assignments(supervisor_id, site_id, valid_from, created_by)
  select requested_id, saved_site_id, current_date, p_actor_id
  from (select distinct unnest(coalesce(p_supervisor_ids, array[]::bigint[])) as requested_id) requested
  where exists (select 1 from public.supervisors where id = requested.requested_id)
    and not exists (select 1 from public.supervisor_site_assignments a where a.supervisor_id = requested.requested_id and a.site_id = saved_site_id and a.valid_to is null);
  if exists (select 1 from unnest(coalesce(p_supervisor_ids, array[]::bigint[])) as item(id) where not exists (select 1 from public.supervisors where supervisors.id = item.id)) then raise exception 'A selected supervisor was not found'; end if;
  insert into public.field_officer_site_assignments(field_officer_id, site_id, valid_from, created_by)
  select requested_id, saved_site_id, current_date, p_actor_id
  from (select distinct unnest(coalesce(p_field_officer_ids, array[]::bigint[])) as requested_id) requested
  where exists (select 1 from public.field_officers where id = requested.requested_id)
    and not exists (select 1 from public.field_officer_site_assignments a where a.field_officer_id = requested.requested_id and a.site_id = saved_site_id and a.valid_to is null);
  if exists (select 1 from unnest(coalesce(p_field_officer_ids, array[]::bigint[])) as item(id) where not exists (select 1 from public.field_officers where field_officers.id = item.id)) then raise exception 'A selected field officer was not found'; end if;

  return saved_site_id;
end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sync_guard_legacy_assignment()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
begin
  if pg_trigger_depth() > 1 then return new; end if;
  if tg_op = 'INSERT' then
    if new.site_id is not null then
      insert into public.guard_site_assignments (guard_id, site_id, valid_from, assignment_notes)
      values (new.id, new.site_id, coalesce(new.joining_date, current_date), 'Migrated from legacy guards.site_id')
      on conflict (guard_id, site_id) where valid_to is null do nothing;
    end if;
  elsif new.site_id is distinct from old.site_id then
    if new.site_id is null then
      update public.guard_site_assignments set valid_to = current_date
      where guard_id = new.id and valid_to is null;
    else
      insert into public.guard_site_assignments (guard_id, site_id, valid_from, assignment_notes)
      values (new.id, new.site_id, coalesce(new.joining_date, current_date), 'Added through legacy guards.site_id compatibility')
      on conflict (guard_id, site_id) where valid_to is null do nothing;
    end if;
  end if;
  return new;
end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sync_guard_legacy_site_pointer()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
declare
  affected_guard_id bigint;
  next_site_id bigint;
begin
  affected_guard_id := coalesce(new.guard_id, old.guard_id);
  select assignment.site_id into next_site_id
  from public.guard_site_assignments as assignment
  where assignment.guard_id = affected_guard_id and assignment.valid_to is null
  order by assignment.created_at, assignment.id
  limit 1;
  update public.guards as guard
  set site_id = next_site_id
  where guard.id = affected_guard_id and guard.site_id is distinct from next_site_id;
  return null;
end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.validate_advance_adjustment()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
declare
  original_amount numeric(12,2);
  current_adjustment_total numeric(12,2);
  recovered_total numeric(12,2);
begin
  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(new.advance_id);
  select amount into original_amount from public.advances where id = new.advance_id for update;
  if original_amount is null then raise exception 'Advance record was not found'; end if;
  select coalesce(sum(amount_delta), 0) into current_adjustment_total
  from public.advance_adjustments where advance_id = new.advance_id;
  select coalesce(sum(amount), 0) into recovered_total
  from public.advance_recoveries where advance_id = new.advance_id;
  if new.adjustment_type = 'reversal' and new.amount_delta <> -(original_amount + current_adjustment_total - recovered_total) then
    raise exception 'Reversal must cancel the exact remaining advance balance';
  end if;
  if original_amount + current_adjustment_total + new.amount_delta <= 0 and new.adjustment_type <> 'reversal' then
    raise exception 'Adjustment must leave a positive remaining advance balance';
  end if;
  if exists (select 1 from public.advance_recoveries where advance_id = new.advance_id)
    and original_amount + current_adjustment_total + new.amount_delta <
      (select coalesce(sum(amount), 0) from public.advance_recoveries where advance_id = new.advance_id) then
    raise exception 'Adjustment cannot reduce an advance below the amount already recovered';
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.validate_advance_recovery()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
declare
  original_amount numeric(12,2);
  adjustment_total numeric(12,2);
  recovered_total numeric(12,2);
begin
  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(new.advance_id);
  select amount into original_amount from public.advances where id = new.advance_id for update;
  if original_amount is null then raise exception 'Advance record was not found'; end if;
  select coalesce(sum(amount_delta), 0) into adjustment_total from public.advance_adjustments where advance_id = new.advance_id;
  select coalesce(sum(amount), 0) into recovered_total from public.advance_recoveries where advance_id = new.advance_id;
  if new.amount + recovered_total > original_amount + adjustment_total then
    raise exception 'Recovery exceeds the remaining advance balance';
  end if;
  return new;
end;
